rationale: Rules need version/effectivity/provenance and independent administration
Ordered governed rule composition needs independent identity/version and execution reference
Membership/order/applicability belongs to relationship between rule set and rule
Evaluation must bind exact subject/context/rule-set version and retain reproducible evidence
Per-rule result belongs to one evaluation run
Material conflict can require correction waiver disposition and closure evidence
Valid relationship rules require governed scope/effectivity and independent policy history
Reusable semantic/default mapping policy requires versioned scope and precedence
Session/meeting has participants schedule status subject links and retained record
Thread needs independent subject state participants and history
Contribution/comment has authorship draft/published state timestamp and attachments
Subscription is user/team interest state and must remain independent from permission
Collection has owner/context and membership history without owning referenced objects
Cross-context reference needs type provenance/effectivity without altering context hierarchy
Versioned governed type identity needs inheritance object-family compatibility and independent administration
Reusable attribute semantics must be versioned independently from any one domain type
Requiredness cardinality order local label and default belong to the governed relationship between type and attribute
Reusable constraints require versioned configuration and independent assignment provenance
Constraint ordering and mandatory/advisory mode belong to the attribute-assignment relationship
Controlled value sets require governed identity version and effectivity independent from consuming attributes
Enumeration values are controlled children with stable code label order external mapping and status
Named versioned selection logic needs independent identity effectivity administration and reproducible execution reference
Ordered criterion type configuration and mandatory/advisory behaviour belong to one resolution definition
A run binds exact definition context inputs evaluation instant and terminal resolution outcome
Per-item selected version criterion conflict/unresolved state and source evidence belong to one resolution run
A package is a versioned freezeable exchange snapshot with purpose source context exact membership checksum and independent history
Exact subject version representation external identity role and checksum belong to package membership without becoming a new business master
Dispatch has independent reference sequence transport evidence optional Transmittal link and incremental base
Recipient-specific target system/context/reference and optional Transmittal Recipient linkage must remain distinct from package and delivery
Receipt validation mapping import or rejection are receiver-side control states independent from sender dispatch and acceptance
Context type lifecycle classification version and custom source-to-target mappings belong to a specific Received Delivery
Incremental NEW CHANGED MOVED DELETED and ABSENT semantics need explicit subject/base evidence including subjects absent from the current package
Master authority transfer is an explicit approved Decision-backed act after import and cannot be inferred from transmission receipt acceptance or import
A governed external system target needs stable identity direction transport capability recipient and closed-loop acknowledgement/result policy independent from any one publication
One endpoint-scoped idempotent business publication transaction requires independent status resubmission lineage timing and exact activity evidence
Each object×endpoint operation binds exact subject version outbound envelope source-authority rule sequence and independent transport/business state within one transaction
Technical retries must retain attempt number exact payload outbox correlation transport reference timing and failure evidence without becoming new business transactions
Downstream receipt or transport acknowledgement is independently attributable evidence and must not be collapsed into business application success
Downstream applied/no-change/warning/rejected/failed outcome requires exact acknowledgement-attempt correlation and closes business state separately from transport delivery
Object- or attribute-family system-of-record authority needs explicit governed identity effectivity priority and endpoint/external ownership rather than inference from integration success
A migration requires independently governed scope source/target systems cutover strategy approval state and history rather than being represented by an import job alone
Transformation semantics need immutable versioned checksum-backed identity so every run can prove exactly which mapping rules were executed
Dry-run rehearsal and production execution need independent identity timing status mapping reference concurrency control and reconciliation boundary
Each source object outcome must retain exact IMPORT envelope checksum source identity target object/version External Identity provenance and diagnostic evidence within one run
Identity mapping validation version authority duplicate and data conflicts require stable identity severity state and independent resolution evidence because they can block migration semantics
Use-source use-target map waive retry and exclude outcomes require explicit rationale an approved Decision and attributable disposer rather than silent loader heuristics
Pre-cutover cutover and post-cutover reconciliation checkpoints independently aggregate exact source/target evidence counts conflict state and verification outcome
Production cutover is a distinct authority-backed Decision after VERIFIED reconciliation and explicitly establishes the effective NuBlox Source Authority Rule; it cannot be inferred from load success
